title: First-party search-economy arm: extractor sound, code_node embed text too thin for NL recall evidence chunk 4
summary: CONCLUSION: Our pipeline feeds the KB end-to-end and the extractor matches cmm's symbol coverage. The first-party number lands lower than ~0.58 ONLY because the productized code_node embed text is thinner than what the cmm bench embedded — the extractor populates name/signature/file but not summary, and codeNodeEmbedText embeds nothing else. The fix is a representation change at ingest, not an extractor change: fold a bounded source-body (or doc-comment) snippet into the code_node summary/embed text. With that one change the first-party arm beats cmm/subconscious on recall AND on token economy (best tok-per-correct of all arms). Prod :8787 untouched throughout; isolated daemon + temp worktree + temp ORCH_DATA cleaned up.
